title: review follow-ups of PR #37726: the approvals skill does not say what a deleted pending record leaves of its parked flow run
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (review follow-ups, one card per PR) · Source: fleet (Contract review records 7207215155 and 7207498375 on PR #37726, an ungraded note adopted at ACCEPT)

## What happens

PR #37726 (Fixes #37713) teaches, in `skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md`, that deleting a pending record still lands, cancels the approval request and cascades its `master_detail` rows. The review noted one thing the skill does not say: the delete cancels the request, but it neither resumes nor cancels the flow run parked on that approval. So neither the flow's `approve` branch nor its `reject` branch runs, and the run stays parked.

- [ ] **Decide the platform side.** Is a run left parked on a request its record's delete cancelled intended (`plugin-approvals` `cancelForDeletedRecord`, and the flow run's resume path)? If not, file the fix (cancel or fail the parked run). If it is, say so in the approvals docs.
- [ ] **Teach the outcome.** Once the platform side is settled, the skill says in one clause what an author's flow sees after such a delete, within the token ceiling.

Category ①: a behaviour the shipped skill leaves untaught, possibly a platform gap.
Priority: p3 (a delete of a pending record is rare and visible; the run's state does not change any data).
Business reason: an author whose approval flow sends a notification or updates another record on `reject` will see nothing happen when the record is deleted mid-approval, and no doc says why.
Reader: the automation lane, or the area that next touches `plugin-approvals` cancellation.
Dedupe: searched open issues for `"PR #37726"`: 0 hits.
Related: #37713, #37529, PR #37726, PR #37707.

## Grade

area:ai · Bug · minor · reach: read (the plugin on `main`) · evidence: read → p3
